name: Native Stereoscopic
summary: First-party stereo support built into the game by the developer. No mods or injectors required. Typically outputs Side-by-Side or Top-and-Bottom. Examples include Shadow of the Tomb Raider, FEZ (anaglyph), and Limbo (anaglyph).
compatibility_notes: Output options are fixed by the developer — usually limited to SBS, TAB, or anaglyph. Cannot be extended without additional tools. Most reliable option when available.
